## 📌 Description
Provide a concise overview of what this pull request changes and the rationale behind it.

## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #[issue-number]

## 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 💡 New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🎓 Curriculum addition / refinement
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX improvement or styling
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance or refactoring
- [ ] ⚠️ Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing behavior to change)

## 🧪 How Has This Been Tested?
Please describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Manual test in browser (Chrome/Firefox/Safari)
- [ ] Unit / Integration tests added or passed
- [ ] Mobile & responsive layout verification
- [ ] Distraction-free check (ensuring no algorithmic noise is introduced)

## 📋 Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own changes
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in complex logic
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules
